verdict.rationale: Green & Spiegel has a dedicated small-business/start-ups practice that covers employees beyond founders, including long-term immigration policy, document maintenance and visas for key employees. It also offers business immigration aimed at both 'your enterprise and your employees.' The evidence is marketing-level only and never describes how the firm handles many cases at once for a growing team. Missing for 10: documented multi-case or portfolio management for scaling teams, specifics on how a scale-up program works beyond the founder, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, I can run visas for a growing team through one provider — multi-case management or a stated startup/scale-up program beyond single founder cases

citations.quote: Whether it is creating a long-term immigration policy, helping with document maintenance or processing visas for key employees, Green and Spiegel U.S. is the perfect firm
we are able to craft proactive immigration solutions that are both cost-effective and efficient for both your enterprise and your employees.
we endeavor to understand your business fully and your specific needs as a start-up entrepreneur or small business owner/manager
